# `trim_trailing_whitespace`

Remove trailing whitespace from each line.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `true` |  |
| `false` |  |

**Default:** `true`

## Conformance

No known case where Curb's output is not a fixed point of `dotnet format` — see [conformance](../../design-principles/conformance.md).

### `trim_trailing_whitespace = true`

```ini
trim_trailing_whitespace = true
```

::::{tab-set}

:::{tab-item} Before
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public int Value { get; set; }

    public int Double()
    {
        return Value * 2;
    }
}
```
:::

:::{tab-item} After
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public int Value { get; set; }

    public int Double()
    {
        return Value * 2;
    }
}
```
:::

::::

### `trim_trailing_whitespace = false`

```ini
trim_trailing_whitespace = false
```

::::{tab-set}

:::{tab-item} Before
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public int Value { get; set; }

    public int Double()
    {
        return Value * 2;
    }
}
```
:::

:::{tab-item} After
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public int Value { get; set; }
    
    public int Double()
    {
        return Value * 2;
    }
}
```
:::
